diagnosis_en: Nasdaq Watcher: the index is below its 200-day moving average, so the primary trend has turned down. Momentum is -13.57% over 1 month and -15.56% over 3 months, and RSI 27 is oversold (<30) — washed out, prone to a bounce. It sits 19.8% below its 52-week high. The 200-day line is the key level to watch — losing it would flip the primary trend.
